camel_example: aliyun iot CreateDeviceDynamicGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName grouptest --IotInstanceId 'iot-000' --GroupDesc test --DynamicGroupExpression 'product_key_=_a1000_and_name_LIKE_test%'
description_en: Creates a dynamic group and adds devices that meet the dynamic group conditions to the group
description_zh: 创建动态分组，将符合动态分组条件的设备加入分组
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-device-dynamic-group --iot-instance-id iot-000 --group-desc test --group-name grouptest --dynamic-group-expression product_key_=_a1000_and_name_LIKE_test% --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDeviceDynamicGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the group. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character
parameters.help_zh: 分组描述。长度不超过100个字符，一个中文占一个字符
parameters.name: group_desc

parameters.help_en: The name of the group. The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 分组名称。名称长度为4~30个字符，可包含中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。一个中文占两个字符
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The dynamic group rule, which is used to query and dynamically match devices to the group. For more information about how to write rule expressions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185713.html
parameters.help_zh: 动态分组规则，用于查询并动态匹配设备到分组。规则表达式编写方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185713.html
parameters.name: dynamic_group_expression
